drafted_from: the tool row in tool-rows.json and do-work/controls-check.mjs; read them before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check that everything waiting on me has a working control", giving the waiting cards. It tells you which have nothing to press, no place to do them and no steps.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes the cards it is given and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Check that everything waiting on me has a working control", and give it the cards (each with its id, title and the place or steps it names).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run and tool tool:check-that-everything-waiting-on-a-person-reaches-them with the cards as its input.
3. Read the count and the broken list: each broken card says why it has no control.
4. Fix each broken card by giving it a place to do it, a press or its steps, then check again.

worked_examples.title: A card with nothing to press is listed as broken
worked_examples.ask: Check that everything waiting on me has a working control.
worked_examples.given: One card, Allow the camera, with no press, no place and no steps.
worked_examples.hands_back: Without a control: 1. It lists "Allow the camera" with the reason: nothing to press, no place in the app, no steps.
